top_signals.title: Stock traders warm up to Warsh as volatility index touches year-to-date low
top_signals.summary: The Cboe Volatility Index (VIX), which measures the price of 30-day options on the S&P 500 Index, fell to as low as 14.1.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Christina Ruffini's Boot Budget
top_signals.summary: Bloomberg's Christina Ruffini joins Scarlet Fu on "Bloomberg Money." They discuss Christina's spendings habits that often center around Frye boots.  (Source: Bloomberg)
